CustomField.label: Count Must Be
CustomField.description: Part of the applicability gate only - not the main pass/fail check. Sets how the count from "Applies When (Count Query)" is compared to "Count Value"; the check runs only when this comparison is true. Required when "Applies To" is "When a count query matches". Choices: "Equal to", "Not equal to", "Greater than", "At least" (greater than or equal), "Less than", "At most" (less than or equal).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Applicability gate only. How the count is compared to "Count Value", e.g. "Greater than" with a "Count Value" of 0 runs the check only when at least one row matches. Required when "Applies To" = "When a count query matches".
